author: David Bombal
description:
Should schools have to accept generative AI to keep Google Search? Expected changes in early 2027 raise questions about Google Gemini, student research and critical thinking. Schools can disable Gemini separately, but keeping Search without its generative AI features is the catch. Would you accept that deal for your child’s school?

#googlegemini #aiineducation #googlesearch
title: Ban AI, Lose Google SEARCH?
